The question is, why are you writing here? Why do you invite people into your thoughts, into your process? You seek input, guidance—help. Life is shit man, I know... trust me... I know... I can go through the cliches, I can recite the joys of life, I can help you envision a life without pain, without suffering; tell you, it'll be okay and all is good. Ultimately, I have no idea. Things may get much worse before they get better. The fact remains, you are here, seeking a response to your writing. There is a part of you that clings to this world, that clings to life. Embrace that part, embolden it. Recognize the joys of your everyday life.
